sky cinema premiere.desc: A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

sky cinema premiere.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema premiere.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema premiere.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema premiere.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema action.title: Constantine
sky cinema action.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables
sky cinema action.desc: A group of mercenaries is double-crossed during a mission and are approached by Church to overthrow the ruthless dictator of a South American country. It isn't long before the men realise things aren't quite as they appear, finding themselves caught in a dangerous web of betrayal. Although their mission is compromised and an innocent is in danger, soldier of fortune Barney and his comrades decide to get the job done.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables 2
sky cinema action.desc: Mercenary Barney Ross and his team cut a swath of destruction through opposing forces as they take revenge for the vicious murder of a comrade.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables 3
sky cinema action.desc: After a former associate makes it his mission to end the Expendables, Barney Ross assembles a team of younger recruits to help take down their enemy.

sky cinema action.title: Justice League
sky cinema action.desc: Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity, and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater threat. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to recruit a team to stand against this newly-awakened enemy. Despite the formation of an unprecedented league of heroes in Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash, it may be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
sky cinema family.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

sky cinema family.title: Stuart Little
sky cinema family.desc: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

sky cinema family.title: Stuart Little 2
sky cinema family.desc: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

sky cinema family.title: Liar Liar
sky cinema family.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Man With Two Brains
sky cinema comedy.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

sky cinema comedy.title: Tootsie
sky cinema comedy.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mamma Mia!
sky cinema comedy.desc: Set on a Greek island, a young woman who is about to be married suspects that any one of three men could be her father. She invites them all to her wedding without telling her mother. Movie adaptation of the musical, set to Abba's greatest hits.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
sky cinema comedy.desc: Ron Burgundy tries to stay classy when he and his team take New York and the nation's first 24-hour global cable news network by storm.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Slingshot
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: An astronaut struggles to maintain his grip on reality during a possibly fatally compromised mission to Saturn's moon, Titan.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Army of Darkness
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pitch Black
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A deep space transporter crash-lands on a desolate planet circled by three suns. Among the survivors are pilot Carolyn Fry, mystic Abu `Imam' al-Walid, cop William J Johns and convicted criminal Richard B Riddick, and their first thoughts are of survival and escape. Then Fry finds out that the planet suffers a total eclipse every 22 years, which is when the hibernating, flesh-eating inhabitants awake and hunt.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws III
sky cinema thriller.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Accountant
sky cinema thriller.desc: A mild mannered, socially weird government accountant moonlights as a highly trained, and deadly assassin.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mulholland Drive
sky cinema thriller.desc: An actress bonds with an amnesiac in director David Lynch's surreal Hollywood tale.

sky cinema thriller.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema thriller.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema greats.title: The Last Starfighter
sky cinema greats.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

sky cinema greats.title: Gattaca
sky cinema greats.desc: The world of genetically engineered children has come to pass, and people are divided into two classes - valid and invalid. The valid are the chosen ones, given the best jobs and are entitled to the best of everything. Vincent Freeman is not a valid, although he harbours a secret desire to join the space programme. He meets a crippled valid who helps him assume his identity in order to fulfil this dream.

sky cinema greats.title: Lake Placid
sky cinema greats.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

sky cinema greats.title: Deep Impact
sky cinema greats.desc: Apocalyptic thriller in which life on Earth is threatened by a rogue comet. When a reporter in pursuit of a Washington sex scandal is arrested by the FBI, she discovers that the story is an inconsequential part of a huge cover-up. She soon finds herself in possession of the biggest story in the history of humankind - the planet will be destroyed in one year, unless a risky outer-space mission can deflect the comet.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max
sky cinema greats.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

sky cinema drama.title: Plainclothes
sky cinema drama.desc: In the 1990s, an undercover officer is told to entrap and apprehend gay men only to find himself drawn to one of his targets.

sky cinema drama.title: The Cut
sky cinema drama.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

sky cinema drama.title: Grease
sky cinema drama.desc: High-spirited musical set in 1950s America, in which a girl and boy who met on the beach are unexpectedly reunited at high school. She cannot understand how different he has become. Can the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-Birds really be the same person? Perhaps her new friends, the Pink Ladies, can help her win back his heart?

sky cinema drama.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
sky cinema drama.desc: A single father and his young son endure many hardships as the father struggles to provide a better future for both of them.

sky cinema drama.title: Cast Away
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of Fedex snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.
